reasons.animation_fidelity: Motion genuinely works: across the three frames the clouds drift, the boom/stick/bucket digging cycle moves, the dirt pile reshapes, exhaust puffs appear and a Zzz floats upward. Source uses real keyframe cycles (boom/stick/bucket/track/spin).
reasons.richness_detail: Richly layered with 12 gradients, two patterns, distant hills/cranes, rocks, cones, caution stripes, sun rays, a dirt pile with falling clods, and detailed excavator/sloth shading across roughly 261 elements.
reasons.composition_aesthetics: Balanced landscape framing: excavator left-center, dirt pile right, sun upper-right, clouds spread across the sky. Warm yellow/blue palette harmonizes; legible, uncluttered and polished.
